limits: fixed COCO inputs and five repetitions per payload; no reliable P99/P99.99 or steady-state claim
stock text uses CUDA, replacement text uses CPU; mixed-query totals are not a performance ranking
Ray datasets are per synchronous RM in this adapter; observed per-graph model creation is not a framework-wide limit
fused Ray uses one resource-owning callable and loses separate CPU/GPU overlap
source bytes are accepted only for the same currently unchanged verified PIL objects
eager setup is separate; actual lazy/per-call model loads remain in index/query execution
native API timer includes opt-in model observation and private full-vector retention
Arrow views remove Python float boxing, but final concat/reorder/RM assembly still copy
PNG/native input elapsed differences are observations, not isolated adaptation cost
